card.name: Words inside ALL-CAPS warning text
card.fires_on: Words and word endings inside sentences written entirely in capital letters, especially boxed or emphasized warnings. It fires on the next word in an all-caps phrase, such as BE, USE or HOUR, or a split-off ending like LY.

modes.label: Capitalized auxiliary verbs
modes.description: Verbs like BE or HAS in all-caps instructions about injection or use.

modes.label: Partway through capitalized words
modes.description: Pieces of a long capitalized word, such as a first letter or an ending.
modes.example: THIS RATE IS AN UNDERESTIMATE BECAUSE OF UNDER REPORTING, AND THE TRUE RATE COULD BE CONSIDERAB<<LY>> GREATER THAN THIS.

modes.label: Capitalized nouns and prepositions
modes.description: Short words like USE, IN or HOUR within capitalized headings or warnings.
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Cocaine hydrochloride is for TOPICAL<< USE>> ONLY. NOT FOR INJECTION OR OP

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with capitalized word beginnings such as DE, EN, BE and AN.
card.plain: It marks that the text is in all capital letters and helps the model keep writing in capitals.
